tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search the guides, service pages and research on penetrationtestservices.com. Returns titles, URLs and one-line summaries.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Return the Markdown text of a page on penetrationtestservices.com, given its path (for example /guides/).

tools.name: how_to_contact
tools.description: Return the form URL and email address a person can use to contact Excession Labs. This tool does not send anything.

tools.name: request_pentest
tools.description: Send a request for a penetration test or an AI application security assessment to Excession Labs on behalf of a person who asked for it. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site, check_security_headers · Private data: how_to_contact, request_pentest · Public sink: how_to_contact, request_pentest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site, check_security_headers · Private data: how_to_contact, request_pentest · Public sink: how_to_contact, request_pentest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
